6. Stable aliases hide checkpoint names and ports
7. Only one large model resident per GPU/runtime lane
8. Ollama, LM Studio, HF/vLLM separate stores; Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on LM Studio

10. New Qwen releases via separate test profile, never overwrite qwen3.6-35b-a3b
11. Markdown source of truth; narrow HTML viewer with feedback-only mutations
12. One authenticated FirstSpark service owns limited writes, optimistic concurrency, atomic writes, tailnet-only
13. Static generator not write-back owner; weekly Claude/Hermes review draft
14. Frontier hot-swap order NVFP4 -> FP8 -> GLM -> DeepSeek, restore Qwen 3.6 between
15. Port 8100 and distinct aliases isolate frontier lane from SearXNG 8888 and qwen3.6-35b-a3b
